linkedIn.headline: Program Manager at Stryker
linkedIn.about:
Quality Engineer with proven expertise in quality system establishment for the new businesses, new product development, service, risk management, post market quality, and project management. 

Highlights:
•	15 years of engineering experience. 
•	Site quality lead and management representative (Stryker, Ann Arbor)
•	Expertise in QMS establishment for startups
•	People management and mentoring 
•	Tackling complex problems/ projects
•	Project Management and successful execution of large projects
•	New product development 
•	Post-market quality engineering
• Service quality risk assessment 


Certifications:
ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, and ASQ Six Sigma Black Belt

experiences.title: Sr. Staff Quality Engineer, Service
experiences.description:
•	Engineering lead for implementing SAP, change management and updating Service QMS to reflect new ERP for the Endoscopy division.
•	Led the supplier development of a new strategic supplier by establishing a brand new QMS within a couple of months.
•	Managed service quality and QMS of Stryker Ann Arbor plant.
•	Set up systems to enable new service offerings and drive business growth of the Ann Arbor plant. 
•	Mentored and managed performance of Manufacturing Engineering contractors on new service launches, FDA regulations, and quality system compliance.
•	Created a brand new ISO13485:2016 and FDA 21CFR820 compliant QMS for a new business, registered with FDA, and set up a repair process for the pilot product all under 8 months.
•	Collaborated with corporate and other Stryker divisions in learning and sharing best practices. 
•	Initiated and implemented the Design for Serviceability framework and Fast track change management process for the Endoscopy division (2017) 
•	Implemented a repair process for laparoscopic instruments which led to $250,000/ year cost avoidance for Stryker. 
•	Led a division-wide service risk compliance and remediation project (300 + products; 18 Risk Management Files)
•	Led 5 Successful surveillance and re-certification audits including ISO 9001:2015 implementation audits with 0 findings and 0 observations. 
•	Set up a cost-effective repair process for new product launches at Stryker Endoscopy, San Jose.

experiences.title: Sr. Advanced Quality Engineer
experiences.description:
•	Led quality and supplier activities for the successful launch of Flyte SurgiCool personal protection system (disposable PPE) which was crucial to retaining Stryker's multi-million dollar market share. 
•	Advanced Quality Engineering Lead for Infection Control Segment – Provided quality engineering support for two new product development projects.
 •	Created risk management files, conducted usability studies, utilized Six Sigma concepts and design of experiments to find optimal process parameters for disposable Hoods and Togas seam strength, created supplier PPAP requirements, and raw material inspection sheets, assisted supplier with PPAP, led risk design reviews, supported R&D with Design input, output, verification and validation (DIOVV) documentation, developmental testing, supplier process validation, reviewed design verification testing protocols and reports, ensured DHF compliance with quality system procedures, and provided statistical support.

experiences.title: Sr. Quality Engineer - Risk
experiences.description:
• Led Remediation Project - this effort together with other improvements resulted in improving the Neptune 2 production capacity from 3.5 units per day to over 20 units per day.
• IEC 60601-1 3rd edition compliance – Updated legacy risk management files to achieve 60601 risk management compliance. 
• Risk Subject Matter Expert - Proficient in ISO 14971 risk management, provided quarterly risk training of CQA and Occurrence of Harm modules, created risk management files for new products, facilitated team reviews, and conducted a technical review of risk management files. Created and updated nearly 100 PFMEA, FMECA, and PHA risk documents. 
• Project Management - Led project in updating FMECA, PFMEA forms, and procedures to align with ISO 14971 risk management and IEC 60812. Created PFMEA/ FMECA form that overcomes RPN pitfalls and a methodology to transfer information from FMEA to RMF.

experiences.title: Quality Manager
experiences.description:
Responsible for managing quality at 2 plants; people management; 
•	Led a team of 6 employees consisting of quality technicians, and a quality engineer.
•	Customer liaison, led new product launches, post-market quality, and continuous improvements. 
Successful General Motor QSB ( Quality System Basics) implementation and successful audit.

Created PPAP documentation and prototype documentation.

Maintained ISO TS16949 compliant quality system.
